name: Michelle Stidwell
bio: Michelle Stidwell is a seasoned consultant with more than 30 years of experience advising clients across human resources, operations, manufacturing, and retail. She is recognized for her expertise in coaching, facilitation, learning and development, and sales and marketing. As a catalyst for growth, Michelle helps global teams strengthen interpersonal communication, performance management, leadership, and change management skills. Her focus on sustainable behavior change drives measurable business results for organizations navigating transformation. Michelle’s career includes impact in leadership, recruiting, business development, and sales—providing deep insight into culture change and strategic planning. She is currently building change leadership capabilities with public power executives through TVPPA’s Advanced Certified Power Executive Program, and has partnered with organizations across CPG, finance, agribusiness, restaurants, automotive, healthcare, and education. She holds the following Certifications: Certified Executive Coach with Academy of Creative Coaching, Senior Consultant with Personality Insights, Inc., Master Certified Participant-Centered Facilitator with the Bob Pike Group, Certified Facilitator with BlueEQ™’s Leading with Emotional Intelligence, Interaction Management with Development Dimensions International (DDI) and Korn-Ferry’s Leading an Inclusive Culture and Managing Inclusion.

history.title: Beyond Buy-In: Driving Change with Engagement That Matters
